 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Paige Spiranac is a scratch or better golfer, but the 33-year-old influencer isn't happy with the state of her game.
 The former University of Arizona and San Diego State golfer is taking part in the second edition of The Internet Invitational, hosted by Barstool Sports and Bob Does Sports. Spiranac, who lost out on the $1 million prize last year, remains in contention this year, at least up until Monday's video.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The fifth 2026 Internet Invitational Video will come out at 1 p.m. E.T. on Monday. Spiranac is coming off a rough performance in the fourth episode, released last Thursday. She had the "shanks" and lost her one-on-one match against Claire Hogle.
 Spiranac made a "depressing" admission about the state of her game following that disappointing round.
 "If you ever wonder what the swing yips look like on the course then watch me play in episode 4 of the Internet Invitational lol I caught a nasty case of the shanks right before and never recovered. One of the worst 9 holes I've ever played😂 but that's golf for you," she wrote.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Spiranac not getting too emotional, though
 Spiranac, who cried in last year's Internet Invitational after being accused of "cheating," says that no tears have been shed this year.
 "No tears were shed. By evidence of last year you know when I'm crying," she wrote.
 Her swing looked bad, though.
 "I was in a dark, dark place out there," she added.
 Episode 4 of The Internet Invitational has more than five million views, so a whole lot of people were witnesses to Spiranac's struggles on the golf course.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The former collegiate and professional golfer is hoping to turn things around heading into Episode 5, which comes out on Monday at 1 p.m. E.T.
 Spiranac and other top golf influencers are playing for a $4 million prize.
